Connecting families, schools and communities with drivers they can trust

Ospace is a student transportation service headquartered in Houston, Texas. We match students with dependable local drivers for the school commute, and give independent drivers a flexible way to earn using their own vehicle.

For parents, that means peace of mind: a vetted driver, an in-person hand-over at both ends, and the same familiar face on the school run. For drivers, it means real flexibility: choose your days, choose your windows, and get paid per ride.
Great service begins with great people and real experience.

In the Ride | How an Ospace Student Ride Works
What happens in an Ospace ride: we give you the ride that is near to you, a parent or teacher takes the kids from and to the car, and every student rides buckled up.
We will give you the ride that is near to you!
Ospace assigns every ride to the closest available driver. Drivers spend less time on the road between jobs, and families get a driver from their own neighbourhood.
Ospace driver waving to a parent as the student gets in
The parents or the teacher take the kids from and to the car
Drivers never enter a home or a school building. At every pick-up and drop-off, an adult you know walks the student to or from the vehicle, and the driver confirms the hand-over in the app.
the driver waits at the agreed pick-up spot
a parent, guardian or teacher brings the student to the car
the student is released only to the designated adult
Seat belts on, every student, every ride
Before the car moves, the driver checks that every student is buckled in. No exceptions, no unscheduled stops, no phone use except hands-free navigation.

the driver's location is logged from check-in to drop-off

Drivers earn a minimum of $50 for every two rides, and many earn $150 or more per day by combining morning and afternoon school runs. You are paid per completed ride.
Do I need a special vehicle?
No. Any four-door vehicle manufactured within the last 15 years, clean and in good working order, qualifies. You drive your own car.
School runs happen on weekday mornings (roughly 6–9 AM) and afternoons (roughly 2–5 PM). You choose which days and windows you are available inside the driver app.
A parent, guardian or teacher brings the student to and from the vehicle at each end of the ride. Drivers never enter homes or school buildings.
Once your documents, background check and drug/TB test results are in, approval typically takes a few business days. Your portal shows exactly what is still pending.
Ospace drivers are independent contractors. You keep full control of your schedule and drive when it suits you.
